verdict.rationale: Capsule documents its own authenticated REST API at api.capsulecrm.com, with personal tokens or OAuth, for integrating custom applications, so an agent has a first-party channel to work through. Nothing in the pack shows the specific endpoints for creating a lead, populating company data, or assigning an owner, and there is no MCP server; probes also found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt. missing for 10: documented record-creation endpoints, company/organisation data enrichment, owner assignment via API, an official MCP server, machine-readable API spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent enrich a new lead end-to-end via the API or MCP server — creating the record, filling company data, and assigning an owner

citations.quote: API requests are made via HTTPS using the `api.capsulecrm.com` subdomain. Each request must be authenticated with a user's Bearer token.
Use Capsule's API to integrate with your custom or third party application.
you can generate a token directly from your Capsule account to avoid the oAuth 2 flow.
